import pandas as pd
df['요일'] = pd.to_datetime(df['일자']).dt.day_name()
order_map = {'Monday': '월', 'Tuesday': '화', 'Wednesday': '수', 'Thursday': '목', 'Friday': '금', 'Saturday': '토', 'Sunday': '일'}
df['요일'] = df['요일'].map(order_map)
hour = pd.to_datetime(df['시작시각'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
bins = list(range(0, 25, 4))
labels = ['0-3', '4-7', '8-11', '12-15', '16-19', '20-23']
df['시간대'] = pd.cut(hour, bins=bins, labels=labels, right=False)
